units.text: 3) a list of matters on which the civil servant is entitled or required to make managerial and other decisions independently;
units.label: Point 3 Part 2 Art. 47

units.text: 4) a list of matters on which the civil servant is entitled or required to participate in preparing draft regulatory legal acts and (or) draft managerial and other decisions;
units.label: Point 4 Part 2 Art. 47

units.text: 5) time limits and procedures for preparing and considering draft managerial and other decisions, and the procedure for coordinating and adopting those decisions;
units.label: Point 5 Part 2 Art. 47

units.text: 6) the procedure for the civil servant's official interaction, in connection with the performance of official duties, with civil servants of the same state body, civil servants of other state bodies, other citizens and organizations;
units.label: Point 6 Part 2 Art. 47

units.text: 7) a list of state services (types of activity) provided at the request of citizens and organizations in accordance with the administrative regulations (or another regulatory legal act) of the state body;
units.label: Point 7 Part 2 Art. 47

units.text: 8) indicators of the efficiency and effectiveness of the civil servant's professional service activities.
units.label: Point 8 Part 2 Art. 47

units.text: 3. The provisions of the official duties regulations shall be taken into account when conducting a competition to fill a vacant civil service position or for inclusion in the state body's personnel reserve, when making an appointment to a civil service position without a competition, during attestation, and when planning the civil servant's professional service activities and professional development.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 47

units.text: 4. A civil servant's compliance with the official duties regulations shall be taken into account when they participate in a competition to fill a vacant civil service position or are included in the state body's personnel reserve, when they are appointed to a civil service position without a competition, and when their professional service activities are assessed during attestation or when an incentive is granted.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 47

units.text: 5. Model official duties regulations shall be approved by the relevant state service management body.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 47

units.text: Article 48. Attestation of civil servants
units.label: Art. 48

units.text: 1. A civil servant's attestation shall be conducted to determine their suitability for the civil service position held. Attestation shall include assessment of the civil servant's professional service activities and professional level.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 48

units.text: 2. For attestation, the civil servant's immediate supervisor shall submit a reasoned report on the civil servant's performance of official duties during the attestation period. The report shall be accompanied by information, contained in the civil servant's annual professional service activity reports, on assignments completed and draft documents prepared during the attestation period, and, where necessary, by the civil servant's explanatory note in response to the immediate supervisor's report.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 48

units.text: 3. Civil servants holding civil service positions in the ‘managers’ and ‘assistants (advisers)’ categories under fixed-term service contracts shall not be subject to attestation, except for civil servants holding certain civil service positions to which appointment and from which release are made by the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation, where attestation is required respectively by a Presidential Decree or a Government Resolution.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 48

units.text: 4. A civil servant's attestation shall be conducted once every three years. Attestation of civil servants holding certain civil service positions to which appointment and from which release are made by the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation, where attestation is required respectively by a Presidential Decree or a Government Resolution, may be conducted at other intervals established by those acts.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 48

units.text: 5. An extraordinary attestation of a civil servant may be conducted before the time specified in part 4 of this Article after a decision has been adopted under the established procedure:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 48

units.text: 1) to reduce civil service positions in the state body;
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 48

units.text: 2) to change the conditions of civil servants' remuneration.
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 48

units.text: 6. An extraordinary attestation of a civil servant may also be conducted by agreement between the parties to the service contract, taking into account the results of the civil servant's annual professional service activity report.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 48

units.text: 7. Attestation shall take into account the civil servant's compliance with restrictions, absence of breaches of prohibitions, and fulfilment of the requirements for official conduct and obligations established by this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 48

units.text: 8. A civil servant on maternity leave or leave to care for a child until the child reaches three years of age shall undergo attestation no earlier than one year after returning from leave.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 48

units.text: 9. An attestation commission shall be established by a legal act of the state body to conduct the attestation of civil servants.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 48

units.text: 10. The attestation commission shall include the employer's representative and (or) civil servants authorized by that representative (including those from the state service and personnel unit and from the unit in which the civil servant undergoing attestation holds a civil service position), as well as independent experts included in accordance with part 10.2 of this Article: representatives of scientific, educational and other organizations who are specialists in the relevant fields and types of civil servants' professional service activities, personnel technologies and civil service. Independent experts must constitute at least one quarter of the total membership of the attestation commission.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 48

units.text: 10.1. The attestation commission of a federal executive body under which a public council has been established in accordance with Article 20 of Federal Law No. 32-ФЗ of 4 April 2005 ‘On the Public Chamber of the Russian Federation’, and of an executive body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation under which a public council has been established in accordance with a regulatory legal act of that constituent entity, shall include representatives of those public councils in addition to the persons specified in part 10 of this Article. The combined number of those representatives and independent experts must be at least one quarter of the total membership of the attestation commission.
units.label: Part 10.1 Art. 48

units.text: 10.2. Representatives of scientific, educational and other organizations to be included in attestation commissions shall be invited and selected by the federal executive body responsible for developing and implementing state policy and regulatory legal regulation in the field of state civil service, or by an authorized state body of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, at the request of the employer's representative submitted without specifying independent experts' personal data. This shall be done under the procedure established by a regulatory legal act of the Government of the Russian Federation or by a regulatory legal act of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation adopted with due regard to the procedure established by the Government of the Russian Federation. Representatives of public councils included in attestation commissions shall be designated by decisions of the respective public councils.
units.label: Part 10.2 Art. 48

units.text: 10.3. An independent expert's total period of membership of a state body's attestation commission may not exceed three years. This period shall be calculated from the expert's first inclusion in the attestation commission. The same independent expert may be included in the attestation commission again no earlier than three years after the end of their period of membership.
units.label: Part 10.3 Art. 48

units.text: 10.4. An independent expert's aggregate period of membership of the attestation and competition commissions of the same state body may not exceed three years.
units.label: Part 10.4 Art. 48

units.text: 11. The membership of an attestation commission for civil servants holding civil service positions whose official duties involve the use of information constituting a state secret shall be formed with due regard to the provisions of the legislation of the Russian Federation on state secrets.
units.label: Part 11 Art. 48

units.text: 12. The attestation commission shall be composed so as to exclude the possibility of conflicts of interest that could affect its decisions.
units.label: Part 12 Art. 48

units.text: 13. While a civil servant who is a member of the attestation commission is undergoing attestation, their membership of the commission shall be suspended.
units.label: Part 13 Art. 48

units.text: 14. If a civil servant fails to attend attestation without valid reasons or refuses attestation, the civil servant shall be held disciplinarily liable in accordance with Article 56 of this Federal Law, and the attestation shall be postponed.
units.label: Part 14 Art. 48

units.text: 15. Following a civil servant's attestation, the attestation commission shall adopt one of the following decisions:
units.label: Part 15 Art. 48

units.text: 1) suitable for the civil service position held;
units.label: Point 1 Part 15 Art. 48

units.text: 2) suitable for the civil service position held and recommended for inclusion in the personnel reserve to fill a vacant civil service position by way of career advancement;
units.label: Point 2 Part 15 Art. 48

units.text: 3) suitable for the civil service position held subject to successful completion of further professional education;
units.label: Point 3 Part 15 Art. 48

units.text: 4) not suitable for the civil service position held.
units.label: Point 4 Part 15 Art. 48

units.text: 16. Within one month after attestation, a legal act of the state body shall be issued on the basis of its results, stating that the civil servant:
units.label: Part 16 Art. 48

units.text: 1) is to be included in the personnel reserve to fill a vacant civil service position by way of career advancement;
units.label: Point 1 Part 16 Art. 48

units.text: 2) is to be sent for further professional education;
units.label: Point 2 Part 16 Art. 48

units.text: 3) is to be demoted in civil service and removed from the personnel reserve if included in it.
units.label: Point 3 Part 16 Art. 48

units.text: 17. If a civil servant refuses further professional education or transfer to another civil service position, the employer's representative may release the civil servant from the position held and dismiss them from civil service in accordance with this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 17 Art. 48

units.text: 18. A civil servant may appeal against attestation results in accordance with this Federal Law.
units.label: Part 18 Art. 48

units.text: 19. The regulations on attestation of state civil servants of the Russian Federation shall be approved by a Decree of the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 19 Art. 48

units.text: Article 49. Repealed
units.label: Art. 49

units.locator: Article 49. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 645-ФЗ of 29.12.2022.
units.text: Article 49. Repealed. — Federal Law No. 645-ФЗ of 29.12.2022.

units.text: Chapter 10. REMUNERATION OF CIVIL SERVANTS
units.label: Chapter 10. REMUNERATION OF CIVIL SERVANTS

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.label: Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: 1. A civil servant shall be paid in the form of monetary remuneration, which is the principal means of material support and of incentivizing professional service activities in the civil service position held.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: 2. A civil servant's monetary remuneration shall consist of the monthly salary corresponding to the civil service position held (hereinafter the position salary) and the monthly salary corresponding to the civil service class rank, justice class rank or diplomatic rank conferred on the civil servant (hereinafter the class-rank salary), which together constitute the civil servant's monthly remuneration salary (hereinafter the remuneration salary), as well as monthly and other supplementary payments (hereinafter supplementary payments).
units.label: Part 2 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: 3. Position salaries and class-rank salaries of federal state civil servants shall be established by a Decree of the President of the Russian Federation on the proposal of the Government of the Russian Federation. For certain civil service positions, a Presidential Decree may establish monetary remuneration as a single monetary emolument incorporating the position salary, the class-rank salary and monthly supplements to the position salary for length of civil service, special civil service conditions and work with information constituting a state secret, but excluding bonuses and the monthly monetary incentive.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: 4. Position salaries and class-rank salaries of state civil servants of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation shall be established in accordance with a regulatory legal act of that constituent entity.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: 5. Supplementary payments shall include:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: 1) a monthly supplement to the position salary for length of civil service at the following rates:
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: length of civil service | percentage
units.label: Art. 50 · “length of civil service | percentage”

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: | from 1 year to 5 years | 10
units.label: Art. 50 · “| from 1 year to 5 years | 10”

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: | from 5 to 10 years | 15
units.label: Art. 50 · “| from 5 to 10 years | 15”

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: | from 10 to 15 years | 20
units.label: Art. 50 · “| from 10 to 15 years | 20”

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: | over 15 years | 30;
units.label: Art. 50 · “| over 15 years | 30;”

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: 2) a monthly supplement to the position salary for special civil service conditions of up to 200 percent of that salary;
units.label: Point 2 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: 3) a monthly percentage supplement to the position salary for work with information constituting a state secret, at the rates and under the procedure determined by the legislation of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 3 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: 4) bonuses, including for performance of particularly important and complex assignments, the payment procedure for which shall be determined by the employer's representative with due regard to fulfilment of the state body's tasks and functions and compliance with the official duties regulations (with no maximum limit);
units.label: Point 4 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: 5) a monthly monetary incentive;
units.label: Point 5 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: 6) a lump-sum payment when annual paid leave is granted and financial assistance, paid from the civil servants' payroll fund.
units.label: Point 6 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: 6. Monthly monetary incentives paid to federal civil servants shall be established at differentiated rates for federal state bodies by Decrees of the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 50

units.locator: Article 50. Remuneration of a civil servant
units.text: 7. The procedure for paying the monthly supplement for special civil service conditions shall be determined by the employer's representative.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 50
